description_en: Queries the predicted number of instances in a scaling group
description_zh: 查询伸缩组预测实例数
kebab_example: aliyun ess query-predictive-value --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2025-12-17T08:00Z --end-time 2025-12-18T08:00Z --scaling-group-id asg-2zee0wsy0zkdxxxxx --metric-name CpuUtilization --target-value 60.0 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryPredictiveValue

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the predicted number of instances in the scaling group. The time follows the ISO8601 standard and uses UTC time.

Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组预测实例数的开始时间，按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC 时间。

格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the predicted number of instances in the scaling group. The time follows the ISO8601 standard and uses UTC time.

Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组预测实例数的结束时间，按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC 时间。

格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the monitoring metric of the prediction rule. Valid values:

CpuUtilization: the average CPU utilization.
IntranetRx: the inbound traffic over an internal network.
IntranetTx: the outbound traffic over an internal network
parameters.help_zh:
预测规则的监控指标名称，取值范围：
CpuUtilization：（ECS）平均CPU使用率。
IntranetRx：（ECS）内网入流量平均值。
IntranetTx ：（ECS）内网出流量平均值
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en: The current value of the monitoring metric of the prediction rule
parameters.help_zh: 预测规则的监控指标目前值
parameters.name: target_value
